story.title: Story 0: Foundation — Restructure, Rename, and Config

result.planSummary: Completed the Flow 0 foundation and Flow 6 assignment defaults. The prior pass had moved folders but left the codebase non-compiling: stale relative import paths in 30 files, DerivationType still imported by ~15 consumers after its removal, the lower_band_projection→smooth_turn_compression rename unfinished, composeTurnRendering dropped from the inference adapter, the scheduler ThreadDbOpener return-type wrong, and resolveInferenceProvider both using prompt-template names as derivation-type keys and rejecting (instead of default-filling) missing inference types. Fixed all of that: rewrote every stale import to shared-tech/, replaced all DerivationType usages with string (fixtures now own the local derivation-type list), completed the rename in code/schema/prompts, restored composeTurnRendering, corrected ThreadDbOpener to OpResult<DatabaseSync>, and rewrote construction to validate per-key against DEFAULT_INFERENCE_ASSIGNMENTS, fill inference-type defaults (codex/gpt-5.4-mini) and guard defaults, and accept partial/deterministic-optional configs. Added MIGRATION_V9 (deletes stale lower_band_projection work items, logs a warning) wired into the thread-file history. Rewrote the boundary checker for the flat layout (shared-tech↛domains, no cross-domain internal) and exported checkSource for direct rule testing. Wrote restructure-boundaries.test.ts (11) and assignment-config.test.ts (8), updated all existing tests/fixtures for the rename + new validation semantics + schema v9, re-recorded the red-manifest, and updated 01-tech-arch.md §System Shape.

findingsFixed: 30 files had stale relative imports (../../../shared/, ../../../tech-utils/, ../../shared/, ./types.js) left after the folder moves — rewrote all to shared-tech/.
DerivationType was removed from derivation.ts but ~15 consumers still imported it — replaced all with string; fixtures now own the local derivation-type list.
composeTurnRendering was accidentally dropped from the inference adapter (6 methods → 5) — restored; it is removed in Story 3/4 with the deterministic provider ops, not Story 0.
scheduler ThreadDbOpener was typed (path)→DatabaseSync but openThreadDatabase returns OpResult<DatabaseSync>, breaking the injected call site — corrected the type.

resolveInferenceProvider used PROMPT_NAMES (prompt-template names) as derivation-type keys and rejected missing inference types — rewrote to validate against DEFAULT_INFERENCE_ASSIGNMENTS keys and fill defaults (AC-6.2/6.4).
Extract<string, literal-union> evaluated to never after DerivationType→string in chunk-recovery — replaced with the explicit literal union.
record-red-manifest had captured red-manifest.json's own hash, making it self-stale — removed the self-entry.
findingsSurfaced: Prompt file lower-band-v1.ts is intentionally NOT renamed to smooth-turn-compression-v1.ts: the registry KEY was renamed (smooth_turn_compression), but the tested prompt content is Story 3's deliverable (AC-1.2), so renaming the file now would mislabel placeholder content. AC-0.4 is satisfied via the type-string rename (TC-0.4a).

Deterministic prompt files turn-compose-v1 and chunk-detailed-v1 remain in the prompt registry — their removal is coupled with removing composeTurnRendering/summarizeChunkDetailed from the DerivationProvider interface, which is Story 3/4 scope (the handlers still route them through the provider in Story 0).

The deterministic provider output marker stays "projection" while the method was renamed compressSmoothTurn; the marker is internal test-double text that no AC covers and that inference-adapter/fixtures tests pin.

specDeviations: Prompt module lower-band-v1.ts not renamed to smooth-turn-compression-v1.ts (only the registry key and derivation-type string were renamed). Deferred to Story 3, which installs the tested prompt content and can rename the module then. TC-0.4a (schema/source use smooth_turn_compression, no derivation-type references under the old name) passes.
result.recommendedNextStep: Proceed to verification, then Story 1 (Smoothed-prompt guards). The foundation — flat domain layout, shared-tech consolidation, smooth_turn_compression type, default assignments, guard defaults, enforced boundaries, and the stale-work migration — is in place for Stories 1–5.
